calculation: Terminal tasks with at least one linked attributable repair divided by eligible terminal tasks; publish numerator and denominator.

forbidden_inference: do not infer template causality
do not backfill assignments

calculation: Sum linked provider/host-reported cost for covered task trajectories separately by exact currency, source and cost basis; publish coverage.

exclusions: mixed currency, source or cost basis

coverage.denominator: tasks in the immutable defined-task snapshot with exact identity, time window, cohort and role-template scope

do not convert currency implicitly

calculation: Tasks in each unique task-outcome category divided by eligible attributed terminal tasks; publish numerator and denominator per category.

coverage.denominator: terminal tasks with exact identity, time window and cohort scope

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible attributed terminal tasks exist

do not compare incompatible cohorts

calculation: Eligible packets with at least one valid attributable repair edge divided by all eligible packets; an eligible packet with known no repair remains in the denominator and contributes zero to the numerator.
eligibility: declared time window and cohort or filter scope
exclusions: outside declared time window or cohort or filter scope

coverage.denominator: packets with exact packet identity, supported governance revision, time window and cohort/filter scope
coverage.numerator: denominator units whose repair-attribution input is available, including a known absence of repair

value_semantics.missing: N/A when no eligible packets exist

forbidden_inference: do not infer causal fault

calculation: Sum eligible call durations divided by contributing calls; also publish contributing-call count.

do not infer causality

do not reconstruct missing membership
